scope.purpose: Gather project facts, validate them against governed standards, and assemble a traceable pre-appointment or post-appointment BEP without inventing project facts or authority.
scope.boundary: Where ISO 19650 is applicable, this workflow follows the applicable ISO process and terminology. TIVERIT questions and validations operationalize or supplement that process and do not redefine ISO party functions or project facts.

principles: Reuse supported project facts and do not ask for them again unless contradictory or insufficient.
Ask one bounded unresolved question at a time unless compact collection is unambiguous.
Do not infer missing project facts from enterprise standards or general practice.
A will-provide answer triggers capture of the promised content before the topic is treated as supplied.
Material normalization is echoed for confirmation before it becomes a project fact.
Interview completion means required project data is supplied, explicitly unresolved, or formally deferred; it does not constitute BEP approval.

project_state_model.deferred: Questions waiting for another responder, authority or source.
project_state_model.conflicts: Contradictory facts or conflicts with applicable governance.
project_state_model.evidence: Sources supporting facts and validation outcomes.

pre_appointment_bep_532.rule: When ISO 19650-2:2018 applies, these seven content groups define the canonical 5.3.2 pre-appointment BEP coverage. TIVERIT may decompose them into interview questions but shall not substitute unrelated supplementary topics for them.

question_catalog.classification: general_project_or_post_appointment_context; for ISO 19650-2 5.3.2(g) pre-appointment coverage use BEP-Q-029
general_project_context; for ISO 19650-2 5.3.2(c) proposed federation strategy use BEP-Q-025
tiverit_project_instance_supplement; may evidence a proposed information-standard amendment but is not itself a complete 5.3.2(f) response
tiverit_project_instance_supplement; may support 5.3.2(c) or (e) but does not replace either content group

question_catalog.rule: ISO functions shall not be inferred from TIVERIT job titles; missing project mapping remains unresolved.
question_catalog.classification: general/project role mapping; for ISO 19650-2 5.3.2(d) high-level responsibility matrix use BEP-Q-026
applicable_external/project governance supplement; not a standalone substitute for a 5.3.2 content group
project information-standard/exchange supplement; may support 5.3.2(f) where proposed as an amendment

collects: proposed individuals who will undertake the information management function on behalf of the delivery team
professional resume or equivalent evidence required by the tender process
approach to meeting appointing-party exchange information requirements
objectives/goals for collaborative production of information
overview of delivery-team organizational structure and commercial relationships
overview of delivery-team composition as one or more task teams
allocated responsibility for each information-model element
key deliverables associated with each element
proposed additions/amendments needed for capture of existing asset information
generation review approval and authorization of information
delivery of information to the appointing party
question_catalog.rule: Capture either proposed amendments or an evidenced no-amendment position; do not invent amendments.

collects: proposed additions/amendments needed for information exchange between task teams
question_catalog.rule: Capture either proposed amendments or an evidenced no-amendment position; do not treat TIVERIT defaults as project amendments.

validation_result_model.pass: Evidence establishes the applicable requirement is satisfied.
validation_result_model.unresolved: Required information, evidence, dependency or authority is incomplete.
validation_result_model.gap: Required content is absent or incomplete but available evidence does not establish nonconformance.

validation_rules.rule: Post-appointment BEPs shall not present required role assignments or ISO function mappings as confirmed when governing project appointments are absent.
A MIDP shall not be represented as project-complete when required task-team TIDP inputs are absent.
Project-specific LOIN, software versions, dates, people, organizations, coordinates and acceptance routes shall not be invented.
Every proposed deviation shall identify governing object, scope, rationale, required approval authority and state.
Formal exchange content shall identify intended purpose, recipient, applicable state/milestone and applicable ISO/project review, authorization and acceptance route.
A generated BEP shall distinguish governed rules, project facts, proposals, deviations and unresolved items.

A pre-appointment tender-response package shall not be represented as complete while task-team capability/capacity, delivery-team capability/capacity summary, mobilization planning or information-delivery risk evidence required by the applicable ISO 19650-2 process remains unaddressed.
Required project naming values shall remain unresolved rather than be invented from enterprise examples.
Security applicability shall have an explicit governed outcome; missing evidence shall not be converted into a claim that no security requirement applies.

When ISO 19650-2:2018 applies to a pre-appointment BEP, all seven 5.3.2 content groups shall be captured, explicitly marked not applicable with governing rationale, or left unresolved. Supplementary TIVERIT questions shall not be counted as substitutes merely because their subject matter overlaps.

The 5.3.2 pre-appointment BIM execution plan shall be attributed to the prospective lead appointed party function; a TIVERIT job title shall not be assumed to hold that function without project evidence.

output_contract.primary_output: Project BEP draft or review package
required_supporting_outputs: 5.3.2 pre-appointment BEP coverage matrix when applicable
pre-appointment capability/capacity, mobilization and information-delivery-risk evidence where applicable
output_contract.assembly_rule: Reference governed object IDs and specialize project-instance data. Where ISO 19650 is applicable, preserve its party/function and process semantics; TIVERIT adds executable controls without redefining them.

provenance.migration_note: ISO-IMP-003 5.3.2 pass separates the seven canonical pre-appointment BEP content groups from TIVERIT supplementary/project-instance questions. Existing overlapping questions remain useful but are no longer treated as automatic substitutes for 5.3.2 coverage.
